checklist: Q3 (STRESS-MATRIX 5, WebContent killed during Save): three keepers; ⌘3, ⌘↩, and the page's web content process SIGKILLed 0, 40 and 150 ms later. The sidecars are none or all three, each whole (parses, has its rating), no temp file; the page reloads (the app's policy, limit raised so all three reload), the shoot reopens with its decisions; what Quit would say about unsaved keepers is measured. Then Save again writes the three and Quit has nothing to ask.

steps.why: three kills here, all must reload: the limit is not what this measures
